subject: Close playbook: security staging & retention concessions — Meridian Labs MAP
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Caldwell <emma@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Close playbook: security staging & retention concessions — Meridian Labs MAP

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — nice to align on priorities. Per our call, I put together a one-page MAP extract with proposed staging for the security gates you flagged (SOC 2 evidence review, SIG/CAIQ deep dive, and DPA execution) plus a few retention concession options that should unblock your compliance team. Attached: proposed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP milestones + owners).

High-level proposal:
- Stage A (week 1–2): SOC 2 evidence handoff. We’ll deliver a scoped evidence pack (system descriptions, control narratives, sample logs) and host a walkthrough with your security engineers. Owner: Jonas / Marissa.
- Stage B (week 3): SIG/CAIQ questionnaire review. We will pre-fill answers where we can and flag open items for your team. Owner: Kimberly.
- Stage C (week 4): DPA redline + signing. We’re prepared to accept commonly requested carve-outs; Kimberley can lead legal trade-offs.

Retention tradeoffs (options we can take into the MAP):
- Option 1 (default): 30 days raw request logs, 12 months aggregated telemetry (no PII).
- Option 2 (compromise): 90 days raw logs for debugging with strict access controls + 12 months aggregated metrics.
- Option 3 (private): Customer-managed private deployment (VPC) with custom retention (negotiated) — longer lead time.

Quick asks from your side to finish the MAP:
1) Confirm which retention option Meridian prefers (1/2/3).
2) Identify who on your side will own SIG follow-up (name + email).
3) Any specific DPA clauses that are blockers up front (e.g., data residency, KMS).

If this looks good I’ll circulate a slightly expanded MAP with dates/owners and a proposed meeting cadence (SOC 2 walkthrough + SIG review).

Thanks — I’ll plan to get the evidence pack into the Drive by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0126

Attachment: proposed_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Emma Caldwell <emma@meridianlabs.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close playbook: security staging & retention concessions — Meridian Labs MAP

Jonas — appreciate the write-up and the options. Quick notes from security/legal triage here:

- Priority order: SOC 2 evidence (high) > DPA (high) > SIG/CAIQ (medium). SOC 2 pieces need to be consumable by our external assurance manager (they prefer packaged artifacts and a short walkthrough).
- Data residency: Meridian requires EU residency for EU customer data. If you plan to use hosted, we need region isolation or a private deployment option.
- KMS: We’d like to know whether Redwood can integrate with our AWS KMS or provide HSM-backed keys for private deployments.

We’ll take retention option 2 as our starting point (90 days raw logs, 12 months aggregated).

SIG owner on our side will be Marco (marco@meridianlabs.com). He’ll coordinate the questionnaire intake.

I attached our internal security requirements doc so you can map against the MAP. We’ll be ready for a SOC 2 walkthrough next Tues (11 Aug) morning — is that feasible?

Thanks,
Emma Caldwell
CISO, Meridian Labs
emma@meridianlabs.com
Attachment: Meridian_Security_Reqs.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Caldwell <emma@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close playbook: security staging & retention concessions — Meridian Labs MAP

Emma — perfect, thanks for the quick priorities.

We can take retention option 2 (90 days raw logs) as the MAP default. A few clarifications so we can capture trade-offs in the MAP spreadsheet:

- EU residency: Hosted instances can be pinned to eu-west region; for full EU residency (including backups/archives) we’ll need a Private deployment (longer lead time) or an enterprise-limited hosted tenancy — we should note both as MAP branches.
- KMS/HSM: For Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed KMS; hosted customers can use Redwood-managed keys with per-tenant isolation and audit logs. I’ll have engineering add a short KMS row to the evidence packet.

We’re good to run the SOC 2 walkthrough on Tue 11 Aug at 10:00 AM PT. I’ll send a calendar invite and share the evidence pack beforehand (system description, control narratives, sample logs, access matrix).

Jonas

Forwarding with legal summary / suggested playbook for MAP milestones and DPA posture.

Please see my proposed staging:
- Week 0–1: Evidence upload & SOC 2 walkthrough (deliverable: evidence zip + recording).
- Week 2: SIG/CAIQ pre-fill and Q&A (deliverable: CAIQ with open items highlighted).
- Week 3: DPA redline exchange — Redwood legal will accept standard ML/SG commercial carve-outs; exceptions to escalate to VP Legal.

DPA redline guidance (high level):
- We will accept 90-day raw logs with restricted access as operational logs; we will not accept retention obligations longer than 12 months for raw user content on hosted. Private deployments can be negotiated for longer retention.
- We can add an exhibit for EU data residency to the DPA for customers electing EU-hosted tenancy.

Attachment: redline_summary.docx (short bullets for legal).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — Meridian confirms the MAP as staged and accepts the proposed timeline: SOC 2 walkthrough 11 Aug -> SIG pre-fill week after -> DPA redline week of 24 Aug.

Two final asks before we lock the MAP:
1) Please share the DocuSign link for the final DPA after redlines are addressed.
2) Confirm in writing the retention concession: 90 days raw logs + 12 months aggregated metrics (no PII in aggregated metrics). This will be included in our procurement worksheet as the required security appendix.

If both are confirmed we’ll move to internal procurement and target signature by 31 Aug.
